done.why: I read closely for a short stretch, then left. The opening is pleasant but I had no goal yet, and I stopped without reaching anything.

about: A short walk from a barrow through a cavern with a ravine and a bridge, then down to a hedged underground garden with a gazebo and a shy unicorn that wears a gold key. It reads as a wry, affectionate return to a familiar old cave adventure. I carry a lamp and an Elvish sword that glows near danger or the unicorn.

moments.note: The lantern is described as 'strangely familiar', and the examine text says it has been through one adventure already and would rather not discuss it. It's a sly wink at the earlier game.
The garden is a formal garden inside a cavern. Hedges hide the walls and the moss passes for a cloudy day. It's a lovely image.
The unicorn 'bounds lightly away' and then the examine text says it shies away but has a key. The order of the messages is muddled, and the sword's glow messages are out of step too.
At the Dark Tunnel I tried 'go south' and got only 'You can't go that way.' The two exits it listed were southwest and southeast, so the room text could have steered me better.

wished: Take the key from the unicorn, or lure it closer.
Try the wide southwest corridor and the overgrown break in the hedge.

lines.line: It has that look of a thing that has been through one adventure already and would rather not discuss it.
lines.why: Dry humour that also gives the lantern some history.

lines.line: a dozen planks lashed across two tree trunks that somebody carried a long way, with a rope on either side for the nervous.
lines.why: Small concrete details make the bridge feel built by people.

lines.line: glow a cold, steady, underwater sort of light, enough to see by and not enough to be comfortable in.
lines.why: This is the best sentence I read. It carries the mood in one image.

lines.line: It is the sort of thing one takes tea in.
lines.why: A light, characterful close to the description.

fun.why: The tone is charming, but I didn't play long enough to meet a puzzle or any stakes.

engagement.why: The unicorn with its key and the glowing sword gave me something to follow, but I stopped early.

difficulty.why: The route was linear and the exits were clear. I met no obstacle in the part I played.

interestingness.why: The familiar items, the cavern garden and the unicorn with a key suggest a layered world.

prose.why: The examine texts are well-observed and witty, and the images are precise. The room descriptions are plainer, and some messages arrive out of order.
